style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 120 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, xylophone, kalimba and bright brass hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Stretch up tall, stretch up tall!
The giraffe is the tallest of all!
Reach your arms up, one, two, three,
Stretch up tall and sing with me!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
Long, long legs and a long, long neck,
Up to the treetops, let's go check!
Higher than the zebra, higher than the tree,
The tallest animal, look and see!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is tall? Who is tall?
Stretch up high, the tallest of all!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Stretch up tall, stretch up tall!
The giraffe is the tallest of all!
Reach your arms up, one, two, three,
Stretch up tall and sing with me!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
Leaves at the top, way up high,
Munch, munch, munch, up near the sky!
Out comes a tongue, so long, so long,
It picks the leaves and sings along!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Stretch your neck, stretch, stretch, stretch!
Up on tiptoe, reach for the leaf!
Now wiggle and giggle and stretch so much!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
Look at the spots, brown and bright,
Big ones, small ones, left and right!
No two giraffes have spots the same,
Spotty patterns, what a fun game!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is tall? Who is tall?
Stretch up high, the tallest of all!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Stretch up tall, stretch up tall!
The giraffe is the tallest of all!
Reach up high, one, two, three,
Stretch up tall and sing with me!
Stretch up tall!

[Outro - quick and happy]
We reached up high, stretch up tall!
Stretch up tall, stretch up tall, bye-bye, my friends!

meta.title: Stretch Up Tall! Giraffe Song for Kids with Milo
meta.description:
Stretch up tall! Sing and stretch with Milo the bluebird and the giraffe, the tallest animal in the world: long legs, a long neck, a long tongue for leaves at the very top of the trees, and spots that are all its own.
A giraffe song for kids. Stretch up, tiptoe and reach along. Ages 2-6.

Facts from National Geographic and Britannica Kids (giraffe pages).

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Every fact is checked against trusted sources and every script is reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
